NOTES:

All genos in this notepad appear to "fling" particles in random directions
It appears what is actually being learned is to fling the particles to the right
Later on genos do learn some "fold over" locomotion but end with chaos and flinging particles

Fitness function in this exercise did *NOT* penalise broken springs

Fitness function in day 2 *DOES* penalise broken springs
